canonical_project: Wingu Africa Berbera SL01 carrier-neutral data center
notes: Wingu announced that the first phase of its Berbera, Somaliland carrier-neutral data center was commissioned on 2021-02-13 and ready for service. Baxtel lists Somalia as having one facility, Wingu Africa Berbera SL01, and reports about 1MW for the largest Somalia data center; DataCenterMap places the facility at Batalaale Beach, Zone 20, Beach Rd, Berbera. Assigned to Northwest because the batch uses the legacy Northwest/Somaliland division label; Berbera is often treated separately as Sahil in newer administrative references.
